title_sq: Apartament 2+1 per shitje tek Tirana Entry II!
description_sq:
Ofrojme apartament per shitje ne nje kompleks me cilesi te larte, ne faze te avancuar ndertimi, nga subjekti "Nova Construction 2012"
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e dyte te objektit, me orientim lindje, ne nje nga godinat e kompleksit Tirana Entry II.
Organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje me ambjent gatimi, dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete, (njeri me ajrim natyral) dhe nje ballkon.
Per me teper informacion me kontaktoni.
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Tirana Entry II!
description_en: We offer an apartment for sale in a high-quality complex, in an advanced stage of construction, by the entity "Nova Construction 2012". The apartment is located on the second floor of the building, facing east, in one of the buildings of the Tirana Entry II complex. It is organized in a living room with a kitchen area, two bedrooms, two toilets, (one with natural ventilation) and a balcony. For more information, contact me.
